message.subject: Outdoor durability beyond 2-3 years
message.body:
Hi [Name],

I saw Nazdar's recent sustainability awards and your focus on outdoor durability across the 2800 and 3500 Series—congrats on the recognition.

We work with ink manufacturers looking to push beyond the typical 2-3 year outdoor warranty ceiling, especially for fleet graphics and architectural applications where extended performance creates real competitive separation.

Would it be worth a brief conversation about how some teams are positioning premium ink systems with significantly longer outdoor life? Happy to share what we're seeing work in similar applications.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Nazdar's current outdoor durability warranties max out at 2-3 years, creating a gap in premium pricing power for fleet graphics and architectural applications
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Extreme durability enabling extended warranties and premium market positioning
